description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyColumnGenerator class in the liquibase.ext.sqlgenerator.core package, specifically testing SQL generation and validation logic for modifying database columns across different database systems.

classes.name: ModifyColumnGeneratorTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying SQL generation, validation, and support logic of the ModifyColumnGenerator class.

methods.name: shouldGenerateSql
methods.description: Tests SQL generation for modifying a column with specific constraints on MySQL database.

methods.name: shouldGetDefaultClause
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of default value clauses across different database types.

methods.name: shouldGetModifyString
methods.description: Tests the correct modification string used in SQL for different database types.

methods.name: shouldGetPostDataTypeString
methods.description: Tests the post-data type string generated for various databases.

methods.name: shouldGetPreDataTypeString
methods.description: Tests the pre-data type string for different databases.

methods.name: shouldRejectMissingTableNameAndEmptyColumns
methods.description: Verifies validation errors when table name or columns are missing.

methods.name: shouldRejectAddingAPrimaryKeyColumn
methods.description: Checks that adding a primary key column on certain databases produces appropriate errors.

methods.name: shouldSupportExtraMetaData
methods.description: Tests whether the generator supports extra metadata for various databases.
